description.text: Main Course 1. Language Skill Course: Listening, Conversation, Reading, Character Writing, Intensive Reading, etc. 2. Chinese Literature and Culture Course: Lectures on Chinese culture, Chinese Literature, Film Appreciation, Calligraphy, Painting, Folk Music, Peking Opera, Taiji boxing, etc. 3. Language Practice Course: Extracurricular Language Practices, Folklore Field Study, Visits to Historical and Culture Places, etc. Also, a variety of elective courses are offered as well, such as Business Chinese and Executive Chinese, HSK Preparation, etc. Free Elective Courses Some useful optional course, just like business Chinese, Chinese words, Tourist Chinese, coach for HSK, and free talk, will be arranged most of course in afternoon. (At least 2-4 class in each afternoon) Culture Activity During study period and vacations, the university often arranges various extracurricular language practices, cultural, sports and recreational activities, such as lectures on Chinese history and culture, table tennis matches, performances of Chinese songs, sitcoms directed and played by international students, etc. Duration of Study 6 months or more, 20 hours/week. Different levels of courses are offered: zero level beginning, elementary, intermediate and advanced. Application Time Spring semester begins from February, application before the end of Jan. Those who have Chinese basis can join class anytime during the semester. Tuition RMB 7500 for one semester. Accomodation If you need dormitory on campus, room reservation should be made when application. If dormitories are full, we don't accept any room reservation. You have lived in the International Student Dormitories on campus for two months. Free Fitness There is a gymnasium in the dormitory, and the fitness equipment is free for use.

duration.text: The Long-term Chinese Course at Tianjin University is a 1 Semester long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 902 USD/In total ￥ 6500 CNY/In total

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 2.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 3.High school academic transcript 4.High school graduate certificate Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: An equivalent of China's high-school graduation education or higher; Final education certificate and transcript; Over 18 years in age
